mapper.select: SELECT id, version, answer_key, example_answer, COALESCE(forbidden_terms, '[]'::jsonb) AS forbidden_terms, created_at FROM rubric_version WHERE mission_id = #{missionId} ORDER BY version

SELECT e.id, e.rubric_version_id, e.code, e.label, e.description, e.points, COALESCE(e.common_errors, '[]'::jsonb) AS common_errors, e.good_thought, e.judge_verified FROM rubric_element e JOIN rubric_version rv ON rv.id = e.rubric_version_id WHERE rv.mission_id = #{missionId} ORDER BY e.rubric_version_id, e.sort_order
SELECT h.rubric_version_id, h.content FROM hint_question h JOIN rubric_version rv ON rv.id = h.rubric_version_id WHERE rv.mission_id = #{missionId} ORDER BY h.rubric_version_id, h.seq
SELECT COALESCE(max(version), 0) + 1 FROM rubric_version WHERE mission_id = #{missionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rubric_version (id, mission_id, version, answer_key, example_answer, forbidden_terms, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{missionId}, #{version}, #{command.answerKey,typeHandler=com.sagomungchi.learning.mission.repository.AnswerKeyTypeHandler,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{command.exampleAnswer,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{command.forbiddenTerms,typeHandler=com.sagomungchi.learning.mission.repository.StringListTypeHandler}, #{command.authorId}, #{now})

INSERT INTO rubric_element (id, rubric_version_id, code, label, description, points, common_errors, good_thought, judge_verified, sort_order) VALUES
(#{r.id}, #{rubricVersionId}, #{r.value.code}, #{r.value.label}, #{r.value.description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{r.value.points}, #{r.value.commonErrors,typeHandler=com.sagomungchi.learning.mission.repository.StringListTypeHandler}, #{r.value.goodThought}, #{r.value.judgeVerified}, #{r.order})

INSERT INTO hint_question (id, rubric_version_id, seq, content) VALUES
(#{r.id}, #{rubricVersionId}, #{r.order}, #{r.value})
mapper.update: UPDATE mission SET current_rubric_version_id = #{rubricVersionId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{missionId}
